ConnectionStrings._comment: Local values live in dotnet user-secrets or the environment, never in this file — it is tracked in git. Run: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection" "..." and dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "$(openssl rand -base64 48)"

Telegram._comment: Paste the token from @BotFather into BotToken and set Enabled=true, then restart the API. NOTE: this file is tracked in git — prefer 'dotnet user-secrets set Telegram:BotToken <token>' or the Telegram__BotToken env var so the token is never committed.
